summary: Task 3 implementation in news_bot.py is clean, well-documented, and faithfully implements Decisions 4/11/12 of the tech-spec. Three helpers (SOURCE_EMOJI/SOURCE_LABEL dicts, build_admin_ping, sanitize_error_message) + three env-overridable constants (IDLE_TIMEOUT_HOURS, GRACE_WINDOW_HOURS, QUEUE_CAP). No regressions outside task scope. Few nits only.

findings.finding: Inner try/except around `message.replace(value, '[REDACTED]')` is belt-and-suspenders. `str.replace(str, str)` on well-formed strings cannot raise; the outer try around `str(exc)` already covers the realistic failure mode. Defensive but not wrong.
findings.recommendation: Leave as-is for v1 — task-3 explicitly calls for graceful degradation ('Исключение внутри функции не поднимает'). Extra defense is free and matches spec intent. No action.

findings.finding: Env-overridable knobs `IDLE_TIMEOUT_HOURS`/`GRACE_WINDOW_HOURS`/`QUEUE_CAP` use `int(os.getenv(name, default))` which will raise `ValueError` on malformed env values. Task 3 scope is foundational; Task 6 owns the job loop that actually reads these knobs.
findings.recommendation: Out of scope for task 3. Task 6 can harden if needed. No action.

findings.finding: `_ADMIN_PING_ORDER` hardcoded as a tuple — explicit per task-3 hints ('Явный порядок = стабильность формата на случай будущих рефакторов'). Good.

`Counter(r['source_name'] for r in rows)` uses strict subscript — raises KeyError if any row lacks 'source_name'. Task-3 Edge Cases section explicitly chose strict behavior ('пусть баг проявится рано'). Aligned with spec.
